selectionMethod: A curated selection of title, menu, signature location and boss themes from original in-game soundtracks; typically two to four recordings per game. Different games alternate before another cue from the same game. No external covers, tribute arrangements or club remixes. Official remasters/reissues are identified by the soundtrack source.
metadataMethod: Every selected ID, title, artists and release date was read from Spotify public embed metadata. Each delivered track separately reported isPlayable=true on 2026-11-11. This verifies catalog metadata, not successful audio playback on every account or in every region.
yearNote: Years are exact Spotify release dates for the selected recording; later soundtrack releases/reissues may differ from the year the game first launched. All cards carry review=true and game answers do not use years.

curationReferences.supports: Selected actual tracks Rip & Tear (DOOM), No Escape (Hades), Legends of Azeroth (WoW), and the importance of Celeste and Journey soundtrack canon.
Recommends Nate's Theme (Uncharted), Halo main theme, Dragonborn (Skyrim), Nascence (Journey), and God of War (2018).
